import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 1000005;
    static final long MODA = 998244353L;
    static final long MODB = 1000000007L;
    static final long BASE = 1000000L;

    static long n;
    static List<Integer>[] digits = new ArrayList[10];
    static long counter = 0;
    static int[] prefixSum = new int[10];
    static long totalAnswer = 0;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            digits[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void buildSequences(int level, long value) {
        counter++;
        long val = (counter - value + MODA) % MODA;
        digits[level].add((int) val);
        prefixSum[level] = (int) ((prefixSum[level] + (val % MODB)) % MODB);
        if (level == 6) return;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            buildSequences(level + 1, 10 * value + i);
        }
    }

    static void processSequences(long x) {
        if (x > n) return;
        if (x * BASE + BASE - 1 <= n && x * BASE * 10 > n) {
            long rk = counter;
            for (int i = 0, step = 1; i <= 6; i++, step *= 10) {
                long delta = ((rk - x * step) % MODA + MODA) % MODA;
                int pos = lowerBound(digits[i], (int) (-delta + MODA));
                long size = digits[i].size();
                long sumDigits = 0;
                if (pos != -1) {
                    sumDigits = ((delta * size) % MODB + prefixSum[i]) % MODB;
                }
                long subtract = ((size - pos) * MODA) % MODB;
                long contribution = (sumDigits - subtract + MODB) % MODB;
                totalAnswer = (totalAnswer + contribution) % MODB;
                counter += size;
            }
            return;
        }
        counter++;
        totalAnswer = (totalAnswer + ((counter - x) % MODA + MODA) % MODA) % MODB;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            processSequences(x * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        buildSequences(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(digits[i]);
        }
        counter = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            processSequences(i);
        }
        System.out.println(totalAnswer);
    }
}
